description: Regular grid over Variables (each variable uses parameters.num).
x-jarvis-example:
Method: Grid
Bounds:
  seed: 0
Variables:
  - name: x
    distribution:
      type: Flat
      parameters: {min: 0.0, max: 1.0, num: 10}

Bounds.description: Grid-method knobs. Grid size comes from Variables[].distribution.parameters.num.
